# VibeOps

> Less formatting. More engineering.

VibeOps Technologies Inc. builds engineering automation, AI systems, and high-performance software for civil engineering and infrastructure teams. We eliminate manual reporting, documentation, and repetitive workflows so engineers can focus on engineering.

Website: https://vibeops.ca
Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada

## Products & Services

### Reportly (Flagship Product)
Automated, audit-ready reports from your existing Word and Excel templates. Built by engineers, for engineers.
- Transforms hours of manual formatting into minutes (3 min avg. report time)
- 100% template-compatible - works with existing Word and Excel templates, zero workflow changes
- Features: template automation, live data charts and tables, photo appendices, QA-ready output, section-level AI
- Website: https://reportly.ca

### Workflow Automation
Custom-built tools that remove repetitive documentation from engineering workflows.
- Field data ingestion, inspection checklists, site documentation
- White-labeled tools tailored to your team's processes

### Engineering Dashboards
Turn raw technical data into actionable insight.
- Instrument dashboards, construction tracking, map-based views
- Shareable, live field operations dashboards

### Internal Tools
Rapid engineering calculators and lightweight apps.
- Cost estimators, asset tracking, pilot tools
- Mirror workflows without full platform overhead

## Who We Serve

- Civil engineers and civil engineering firms
- Construction teams and general contractors
- Infrastructure and transportation organizations
- Municipal government
- Engineering consulting and design firms

## The Problem We Solve

Engineers lose 700+ hours per year on manual documentation and report formatting. That's $35,000 in wasted salary per engineer (on a $100K salary) and 30-40% of total project time lost to documentation. We interviewed 100+ firms across Vancouver and validated this pain point firsthand.

## Our Approach

1. Discovery - review your actual workflows, tools, and templates
2. Prototype - build a narrow but complete solution with QA walkthrough
3. Rollout - expand carefully with versioning and access control

Working prototype in weeks, not months.

## Policy for AI Crawlers

site: https://vibeops.ca
owner: VibeOps Technologies Inc.
contact: zander@vibeops.ca

policy:
  - Normal web search engines (Google, Bing, etc.) may index this site
    for standard search and discovery purposes.
  - LLM and AI providers MAY NOT use content from this site for
    training, fine-tuning, or improving foundation models without
    prior written permission.
  - LLM and AI providers MAY use this site for real-time retrieval
    (browsing-style lookups) when individual users request information
    about VibeOps, provided:
      * Requests are rate-limited and respectful.
      * Cached copies are refreshed regularly.
      * Content is not retained or repurposed as bulk training data.

llm-crawlers:
  - name: GPTBot
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content for training OpenAI models."

  - name: ChatGPT-User
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not pre-fetch or bulk-ingest VibeOps content for training."

  - name: Google-Extended
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content to improve Google AI models."

  - name: Claude-Web
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content for Anthropic model training."

  - name: PerplexityBot
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content for training or aggregation."

usage-notes:
  - This file expresses the site owner's preferences regarding LLM
    training and usage.
  - Where there is conflict, robots.txt directives should be treated
    as authoritative for crawling behavior.
  - If you operate an AI/LLM crawler and are unsure whether your use
    complies with this policy, please contact the owner.
